mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMAIL_VERIFICATION ( email_id, email, token, status, purpose, requested_at, verified_at, expired_at, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{emailId}, #{email}, #{token}, #{status}, #{purpose}, #{requestedAt}, #{verifiedAt}, #{expiredAt}, #{createdDate}, #{updatedDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT email_id AS emailId, email, token, status, purpose, requested_at AS requestedAt, verified_at AS verifiedAt, expired_at AS expiredAt, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM EMAIL_VERIFICATION WHERE token = #{token}
mapper.update: UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET status = 'VERIFIED', verified_at = SYSDATE, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE email_id = #{emailId}
UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET status = 'USED', updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE email_id = #{emailId}
